QuestInfo.name: Request of the Test Subject 2
QuestInfo.0: #p2151005#'s medicine should be ready by now. Talk to #b#p2151005##k at the Underground Base.
QuestInfo.1:
#p2151005#'s medicine is finished, but it still needs to be tested. Help her test the medicine by drinking it and successfully defeating the #rTraining Robot#k in #b#m310010500##k. Then, report to #p2151003# while the medicine is still in effect.

#o9300413##r #a231181##k

#r#e* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
QuestInfo.2: #p2151005#'s medicine was incredible! When you informed #p2151003# that the medicine had no side effects and you were able to successfully defeat the Training Robot, she was ecstatic! She said she would think about how the members of the Resistance can use it in the future.

0.0: The medicine is ready! If my guess is correct, this should temporarily boost your ATT and DEF. I don't know if it'll work, though. Plus, there might be side effects... \r\n#L0##bGuess you better inject the medicine into me so we can find out.#l\n#k
0.1: What? You?! You're going to take the medicine yourself? But it could be dangerous, and... Are you sure you want to do this? Do you really trust me that much?

yes.0: (Her eyes tear up.)\r\nI didn't realize you believed in me that much. I know, it's silly to cry, but you've given me confidence. Okay, I'm going to inject the medicine into your arm. Tell me if you start to feel funny.
yes.1: I've heard that there's a strong robot called #r#o9300413##k at #b#m310010500##k. If you can defeat it, you'll prove that the medicine is good! Please #bdefeat #o9300413# while you have the buff from my shot, and then report to #p2151003##k.
yes.2: Thank you so much for trusting me. If it wasn't for you, I don't know where I'd be.

no.0: Right, smart choice. It's medicine that the Black Wings used. Best not to trust it... \r\n(She looks a little sad, though.)

1.0: What's going on, #h0#? Your face looks brighter than usual... Hmm? You're testing #p2151005#'s medicine? You even defeated #o9300413#? Hold on, I want to check your pulse and blood pressure.

yes.0: This is a surprise. You certainly are stronger than before you took the medicine. I can't be hasty, since we're still testing, but you don't seem to be suffering from any side effects.
yes.1: Hm, this was based on a formula used by the Black Wings? And you became quite strong from it. #p2151005# was a great help, providing us with both this information and this medicine. This is all thanks to you, you know.
yes.2: I will considering using this medicine on other members of the Resistance, after much more testing, of course.
